verdict.rationale: Factory documents tiered autonomy for droid exec, which controls which operations can run without manual confirmation. That is a first-party mechanism for reducing per-action approvals, and the interactive CLI also references approvals. However, the evidence does not show a tier or setting that auto-approves all actions, and covers this only for headless exec mode. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of an approve-everything autonomy level, documentation of the tier names and how to configure them, coverage for interactive CLI and App sessions, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can configure an agent to auto-approve all its actions instead of confirming each one

citations.quote: Droid exec uses tiered autonomy to control what operations can run without manual confirmation.
